name: tictactoe-ai-engine
description: Real-time Tic-Tac-Toe with a Minimax vs Alpha-Beta AI engine, online rooms and an algorithm explorer.
author: Amaan Siddique <amaan.siddique.academics@gmail.com>

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server
scripts.test: npm test -w shared && npm test -w server
